title: Classic Indian Chole

ingredients.title: For the Chickpeas
items: Dried chickpeas – 1 cup, or canned chickpeas – 2 cups, drained and rinsed
Salt – 1 tsp for cooking dried chickpeas

ingredients.title: For the Masala
items: Oil – 2 tbsp, vegetable or mustard oil
Red chili powder – 1 tsp, adjust to taste
Amchur (dry mango powder) – 1 tsp, or fresh lemon juice – 1 tbsp
Fresh coriander leaves – chopped, for garnish

instruction.title: Prepare the Chickpeas
steps: If using dried chickpeas, soak them overnight for 8–10 hours in plenty of water.
Drain and rinse the soaked chickpeas.
Pressure cook with about 3 cups water and 1 tsp salt for 15–20 minutes, or boil for 1–2 hours until tender.
Cook until the chickpeas are soft but still hold their shape.
Reserve the cooking liquid for the curry.

instruction.title: Prepare the Masala Base
steps: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds, bay leaf, and dried red chilies if using.
Sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring regularly, until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for about 2 minutes until the raw aroma disappears.

instruction.title: Cook the Spices & Tomatoes
steps: Add turmeric, coriander powder, cumin powder, and red chili powder.
Stir well and cook for about 30 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add the pureed tomatoes and slit green chilies.
Cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes are cooked down and the oil begins to separate from the masala.

instruction.title: Combine the Chickpeas
steps: Add the cooked chickpeas to the masala.
Pour in about 1 cup of reserved chickpea cooking liquid.
Add more cooking liquid if a thinner gravy is desired.
Mix well and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook over low heat for 10–15 minutes so the chickpeas absorb the masala.

instruction.title: Finish the Chole
steps: Add garam masala and amchur powder, or fresh lemon juice.
Taste and adjust the salt, spice, and acidity.
Cook uncovered for another 5 minutes until the gravy reaches the desired consistency.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Serve the chole hot with bhature, puri, or steamed basmati rice.
Add extra lemon juice or amchur at the table for a tangier finish if desired.

chefTips: Chickpeas: Cook dried chickpeas until tender but not mushy so they retain their texture in the curry.
Cooking liquid: Reserved chickpea water adds body and flavor to the gravy.
Spices: Freshly ground cumin and coriander provide a noticeably deeper aroma.
Smoky flavor: Add a small piece of charred dry chili or use a quick dhungar technique with hot charcoal for a smoky finish.
Tanginess: Amchur provides classic chole-style acidity, while fresh lemon juice gives a brighter finish.
Masala: Cook the onion-tomato mixture patiently until the oil separates for a richer, deeper curry.
